notes.title: Sky Fleet Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 
I’m excited to announce that Sky Fleet will be launching on Dec 17th! 

[previewyoutube=6VvZ4YKR3M8;full][/previewyoutube]
